label: Daily Family minutes
help: How many minutes of Family packages this person may use per day. 0 means no limit.

label: Daily Fun minutes
help: How many minutes of Fun packages this person may use per day. 0 means no limit.

label: Daily Health minutes
help: How many minutes of Health packages this person may use per day. 0 means no limit.

label: Daily Home minutes
help: How many minutes of Home packages this person may use per day. 0 means no limit.

label: Daily Info minutes
help: How many minutes of Info packages this person may use per day. 0 means no limit.

label: Daily Learning minutes
help: How many minutes of Learning packages this person may use per day. 0 means no limit.

label: Daily Media minutes
help: How many minutes of Media packages this person may use per day. 0 means no limit.

label: Daily Robot body minutes
help: How many minutes of Robot body packages this person may use per day. 0 means no limit.

label: Daily Utilities minutes
help: How many minutes of Utilities packages this person may use per day. 0 means no limit.

label: Backup storage limit (GB)
help: Once total backup storage passes this, the oldest backups are deleted first - checked after the normal seven-daily/four-weekly/three-monthly schedule. 0 means no extra limit.

label: Chat context size override
help: 0 lets the hub pick the largest context that fits this computer's memory. A higher number can run out of memory; a lower one leaves headroom but remembers less of the conversation.

label: Flash attention override
help: "Auto" lets the hub decide based on the model and the quantized-KV-cache setting. Flash attention speeds up longer conversations; a very old GPU may not support it.

label: KV cache precision override
help: "Auto" quantizes the conversation cache to fit more context in the same memory, with a small quality tradeoff. "Full" uses full precision: more accurate, uses roughly twice the memory for the same context size.

label: Selected chat model
help: The catalog model id currently downloaded and running for chat. Changed through the AI models page, not here.

label: Send photos in chat
help: Adults and teens are on by default; children are off until a parent enables this. Teens control their own setting.

label: How a teen's replies are checked
help: "Sentence" checks every sentence before a teen sees it (the default). "Arrival" shows a teen's reply as it is written and checks it as it comes, so part of a sentence can show before its check finishes and the reply stops there if the check fails. Children and anything spoken always check every sentence first.

label: Reach the engine computer when away from home
help: Off, Home reaches the engine computer only from inside your home network. On, Home may also reach it through your private tailnet when you are away. Turn it on only if you have joined both computers to your tailnet yourself. Only an admin can change this. Shown only while the engine runs on another computer.

copy.does: Allows a private tailnet route to the engine when nobody is at the house.

label: Engine computer name
help: The name of the computer that runs the engine, the way your network knows it. Only an admin can change this. Shown only while the engine runs on another computer.

copy.does: Tells Home which machine to reach for the engine.

label: Engine computer local port
help: The port on this computer where the engine computer's connection appears. Change it only if another program already uses it. Only an admin can change this. Shown only while the engine runs on another computer.

label: Engine computer secure connection port
help: The port Home uses to open its secure connection to the engine computer. Leave it at 22 unless that computer was set up differently. Only an admin can change this. Shown only while the engine runs on another computer.

copy.does: Sets the door Home knocks on to open a secure link.

label: MaiPai Stack address
help: Empty uses Home's own built-in engines. With the engine on this computer, set this to the address of the MaiPai Stack installed here to route chat, embeddings and voice through it. With the engine on another computer, Home fills this in for you from the connection settings, so leave it empty. Only an admin can change this.

label: Help the chat remember to search the web
help: "Off" is the kill switch: nothing is scored. "Shadow" (the default) only counts, as a number, how often a web search looked needed, and changes no reply. "Rescue" is not active yet; for now it behaves like shadow. Children and teens are never scored.

label: Use the MaiPai Stack for chat
help: Off, Home's own engine does this. Turn on only after the Stack has been proven for it. The memory judge and background worker follow this switch because they share chat's model.

label: Use the MaiPai Stack for search (embeddings)
help: Off, Home's own engine does this. Turn on only after the Stack has been proven for it.

label: Use the MaiPai Stack for listening (speech to text)
help: Off, Home's own engine does this. Turn on only after the Stack has been proven for it.

label: Use the MaiPai Stack for speaking (text to speech)
help: Off, Home's own engine does this. Turn on only after the Stack has been proven for it.

label: Where the engine runs
help: "This computer" runs the engine on the machine Home is installed on. "Another computer" runs it on a different computer in your home that you reach over your network. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Picks which computer does the thinking and speaking for Home.

options.this_computer: Home and the engine share one computer.
options.another_computer: The engine sits on a different computer you own.

label: Home Assistant access token
help: A long-lived access token from your Home Assistant profile page, used to control your smart-home devices.

label: Home Assistant URL
help: The address of your Home Assistant instance, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123.

label: Conversation history retention
help: How long chat history is kept before it's deleted. A safety-flagged conversation involving a teen or child is always kept for at least 90 days regardless of this setting.

label: Family name
help: Shown above your greeting on Home, e.g. "Willow" becomes "Willow Family."

label: Home location
help: The household place used as the fallback for location-based answers.

label: Language and region
help: Sets the household's date, time, and unit formatting.

label: Quiet hours start
help: Quiet hours begin at 9:00 pm by default. Safety alarms always override quiet hours.

label: Quiet hours end
help: Quiet hours end at 7:00 am by default.

label: News poll interval (seconds)
help: How often Home checks enabled news feeds. At least 900 seconds.

label: News retention (days)
help: How long Home keeps news items and stories.

label: News shelf
help: Turn the household news shelf on or off.

label: News lists with child controls
help: Which lists of news feeds appear on the news shelf for people using child controls. A list that is not offered to this user type never appears here and is never shown to them. Every item is still checked by the age filter before anyone sees it. A list unchecked for every user type is switched off. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Chooses which news feed lists this user type can read.

label: News lists with teen controls
help: Which lists of news feeds appear on the news shelf for people using teen controls. A list that is not offered to this user type never appears here and is never shown to them. Every item is still checked by the age filter before anyone sees it. A list unchecked for every user type is switched off. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Chooses which news feed lists this user type can read.

label: News lists with adult controls
help: Which lists of news feeds appear on the news shelf for people using adult controls. A list that is not offered to this user type never appears here and is never shown to them. Every item is still checked by the age filter before anyone sees it. A list unchecked for every user type is switched off. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Chooses which news feed lists this user type can read.

label: Extra news feeds for child
help: News feed addresses to add for people using child controls, starting with https:// and separated by commas or spaces. Remove an address to remove its feed. These sit on top of the checked lists. Home checks every item against the age filter, and an address that points inside your home network is refused. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Adds feed addresses to the shelf on top of the checked lists.

label: Extra news feeds for teen
help: News feed addresses to add for people using teen controls, starting with https:// and separated by commas or spaces. Remove an address to remove its feed. These sit on top of the checked lists. Home checks every item against the age filter, and an address that points inside your home network is refused. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Adds feed addresses to the shelf on top of the checked lists.

label: Extra news feeds for adult
help: News feed addresses to add for people using adult controls, starting with https:// and separated by commas or spaces. Remove an address to remove its feed. These sit on top of the checked lists. Home checks every item against the age filter, and an address that points inside your home network is refused. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Adds feed addresses to the shelf on top of the checked lists.

label: Telegram me when someone is asking for approval
Telegram me when backups start failing
Show alerts on this device
help: You'll see a pop-up when MaiPai needs attention, while MaiPai is open. It won't reach you when MaiPai is closed.

label: Telegram me when a Stack engine reports an open warning or critical problem
Telegram me when a Stack engine updates
Telegram me when a Stack engine has an update available
Telegram me when a Stack engine fails to update
Don't notify me about shares from
help: Pick anyone in the household whose shared files you don't want a notification about. You'll still be notified about everyone else's.

label: Telegram me when someone shares a file with the household
Telegram me when someone shares a file with me
Telegram me when I have trouble remembering something from our conversation
Telegram me when I remember something from our conversation
Telegram me when a model download fails
Telegram me when a model finishes downloading
Telegram me when a child or teen's profile band updates on a birthday
Telegram me about new Repairs items
Telegram bot token
help: A bot token from @BotFather, used to send notifications to Telegram. One bot for the whole household; each person links their own chat below.

label: Your Telegram chat id
help: Message the household bot once, then paste the chat id it replies with, to receive your notifications on Telegram.

label: Send time-sensitive notifications to a robot
help: Deliver time-sensitive notifications through a robot channel when one is configured. Private notification content is never spoken.

label: Telegram me when a MaiPai Home update is available
Personal quiet hours start
help: Leave unset to inherit household quiet hours. A parent sets this for a child; teens can set their own.

label: Personal quiet hours end
help: Leave unset to inherit household quiet hours. A parent sets this for a child; teens can set their own.

label: Robot may listen for a follow-up
help: Adults and teens are on by default. Children are off unless a parent enables this.

label: Robot may greet by name
help: Adults are on by default; children are off until a parent enables this. Teens control their own setting.

label: Robot may address this person
help: Adults are on by default. Children are off until a parent enables this; teens control their own setting.

label: Allow playful robot clips
help: Adults are on by default; children are off until a parent enables this. Teens control their own setting.

label: Robot conversation topics
help: Controls optional nudges and chit-chat. Adults get nudges on and chit-chat off by default; children get both off. Teens control their own setting.

label: Allow robot gesture sensing
help: On by default; a parent can change a child setting and teens control their own setting.

label: Robot vision watch level
help: Identity is used only for enrolled people. Children stay at presence until a parent chooses; teens control their own setting. The stricter person and robot levels apply.

label: Personality
help: How MaiPai talks to you: formality, complexity, and how much it follows up on what you say.

label: Show pictures in answers
help: Adults and teens are on by default; children are off until a parent enables this. Teens control their own setting.

label: Reference library location
help: Where the household's offline knowledge archives live: a local folder, an external drive, or a NAS mount. Empty uses Home's own data folder. Moving this later moves the files and updates the library records.

label: Use page views as a news signal
help: Use daily Wikipedia page-view counts to help identify notable news stories.

label: Reference update speed limit (MB/s)
help: Maximum speed used for automatic reference library updates.

label: Reference library update mode
help: Choose whether reference library updates happen automatically or wait for you.

label: Full open-mic interruption
help: Robot-only device setting delivered by Home as settings_changed. Off until arrival-day echo-cancellation measurements pass.

label: Robot camera watch level
help: Robot-only device setting delivered by Home as settings_changed. The stricter of this and each person’s watch level applies.

label: Robot follow-up window
help: Robot-only device setting delivered by Home as settings_changed. 0 disables the window; child access still requires the person switch.

label: Robot gesture sensing
help: Robot-only device setting delivered by Home as settings_changed. Packages may explicitly arm gestures while this is off.

label: Robot greeting style
help: Use a gesture by default; spoken greeting remains subject to person and age-band rules.

label: Robot idle movement
help: Robot-only device setting delivered by Home as settings_changed.

label: Offer acceptance phrases
help: Uses the closed default set: “go ahead” or “yes please” to accept, and “not now” or “no thanks” to decline. No gesture accepts an offer.

label: Allow offers in this room
help: Robot-only device setting delivered by Home as settings_changed. Off until an admin allows offers in this room.

label: Robot initiative
help: When on, the robot may make approved offers. On by default for gestures only; spoken offers remain controlled by tiers_spoken.

label: Maximum offers per hour
help: At most three offers per hour by default; tier 3 is limited to one.

label: Spoken offer tiers
help: Tier 1 may speak; tiers 2 and 3 ask first by default.

label: Allow robot live view
help: Off until an admin enables it. Only admins and adults explicitly named in robot.live_view.who may view.

label: Adults allowed to view the robot camera
help: Admins can view. This list may name adults only; children and teens are never admitted.

label: Allow robot access over the tailnet
help: Off by default. Turn on only after the owner manually joins the device to the household tailnet; Home holds no tailnet key.

default: Smoke alarm. Please go to your grown-up.
label: Child safety alarm line
help: Spoken after a mapped safety alarm for a child.

label: Safety alarm repeat interval
help: Repeat between 10 and 60 seconds; 20 seconds by default.

label: Safety alarm sensors
help: Home Assistant sensors whose alarm events the robot announces. No sensors are selected by default.

label: Safety alarm voice
help: The fixed alarm voice; the deterministic alarm path does not use a model.

label: Safety alarm volume
help: Alarm volume has a hard floor of 70; Home enforces the floor.

label: Look up words online
help: Look up a word online when the library does not have it. The word you ask about is sent to Wiktionary (Wikimedia). Adults only. Off by default.

copy.does: Looks a word up on Wiktionary when the offline library has no entry for it.

label: Search fetch cache limit (GB)
help: Maximum disk space used for cached search pages. The default is 2 GB on p16 and 10 GB on p64 and p128.

label: Safe search level
help: How strictly web search filters results for you. "Default" follows your age: strict for a child, moderate for a teen, off for an adult. A child's is always strict. A teen can make theirs stricter but never lower than moderate. An adult can change their own.

label: Page text check
help: When this is on, text MaiPai fetches from a web page is checked and cleaned before the assistant reads it. It is on by default for Kids and Teens and off for Adults. An admin can change it for everyone or for one person. A child or teen cannot turn it off.

copy.does: Checks and cleans text fetched from web pages before the assistant reads it.

label: Your own SearXNG (optional)
help: Your own SearXNG (optional). Leave empty to use the search service MaiPai runs for you.

label: Search sources
help: Where MaiPai looks for answers: Internet first, Library only, or Library first (the recommended choice). Library only turns off just the live Wikipedia-style lookup; web search stays on unless web search is itself set to Library only. Children and teens keep their current protections in every mode, and this choice never widens what they can reach.

copy.does: Chooses whether lookups use the offline library, the live internet, or both.

options.live: Tries a live lookup whenever the web finds nothing, even if the library has a match.
options.offline: Skips live Wikipedia-style lookups, and web search stays on unless turned off itself.
options.mix: Checks the offline library first, then tries a live lookup only if nothing turns up.

label: Encyclopedia lookups
help: Gives the live Wikipedia-style lookup its own choice. Same as the household choice follows the search sources setting. Library only turns this lookup off. Children and teens never use this lookup in any mode.

copy.does: Sets the Wikipedia-style lookup apart from the household choice.

options.inherit: Follows the household choice for where answers come from.
options.live: Tries a live lookup whenever the web finds nothing, even if the library has a match.
options.offline: Skips live Wikipedia-style lookups, and web search stays on unless turned off itself.
options.mix: Checks the offline library first, then tries a live lookup only if nothing turns up.

label: Web searches
help: Gives web search its own choice. Same as the household choice follows the search sources setting. Library only here turns off web search, link reading, Wayback and the hosted search provider together. Children and teens keep their current protections in every mode.

copy.does: Sets web search, page reads and the hosted provider apart from the household choice.

options.inherit: Follows the household choice for where answers come from.
options.live: Goes to the internet even when the library already has a match.
options.offline: Turns off web search, link reading, Wayback and the hosted provider.
options.mix: Goes to the internet after the library, and only when it has no answer.

label: Web search with child controls
help: When this is on, MaiPai can look things up on the web for people using child controls. Results go through SafeSearch at its strictest, adult sites are blocked, and links are hidden. When it is off, answers come only from the offline library. Only an admin can change this, and a child's searches show in that child's own chats.

copy.does: Lets answers look things up online, or keeps them to the offline library.

options.on: Looks things up online, with the safeguards described above.
options.off: Answers only from the offline library.

label: Web search with teen controls
help: When this is on, MaiPai can look things up on the web for people using teen controls. Results go through SafeSearch at moderate or stricter, and adult sites are blocked. When it is off, answers come only from the offline library. Only an admin can change this. It does not show anyone what a teen searched for.

copy.does: Lets answers look things up online, or keeps them to the offline library.

options.on: Looks things up online, with the safeguards described above.
options.off: Answers only from the offline library.

label: Blocked sites with child controls
help: Which lists of blocked sites are checked when MaiPai searches the web for people using child controls. Adult sites are always blocked for child and teen controls and are not listed here. Home downloads each list once and keeps it up to date. Web search for child controls starts once every list checked here has been downloaded. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Chooses which lists of blocked sites are checked when the web is searched.

options.blp-gambling: Blocks betting, casino and lottery sites.
options.blp-scam: Blocks sites known for fake offers, fake shops and fraud.
options.blp-phishing: Blocks sites that pretend to be a bank or an account page to steal a login.
options.blp-malware: Blocks sites known for spreading viruses and harmful downloads.
options.blp-drugs: Blocks sites that sell or promote illegal drugs.

label: Blocked sites with teen controls
help: Which lists of blocked sites are checked when MaiPai searches the web for people using teen controls. Adult sites are always blocked for child and teen controls and are not listed here. Web search for teen controls starts once every list checked here has been downloaded. Only an admin can change this. It does not show anyone what a teen searched for or which sites were blocked.

copy.does: Chooses which lists of blocked sites are checked when the web is searched.

options.blp-gambling: Blocks betting, casino and lottery sites.
options.blp-scam: Blocks sites known for fake offers, fake shops and fraud.
options.blp-phishing: Blocks sites that pretend to be a bank or an account page to steal a login.
options.blp-malware: Blocks sites known for spreading viruses and harmful downloads.
options.blp-drugs: Blocks sites that sell or promote illegal drugs.

label: Blocked sites with adult controls
help: Lists of blocked sites to check when MaiPai searches the web for adults. None are checked unless you pick them. Scam, phishing and malware lists are a good start for a household that wants that protection. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Chooses which lists of blocked sites are checked when the web is searched.

options.blp-porn: Blocks sites made only for grown-ups.
options.blp-gambling: Blocks betting, casino and lottery sites.
options.blp-scam: Blocks sites known for fake offers, fake shops and fraud.
options.blp-phishing: Blocks sites that pretend to be a bank or an account page to steal a login.
options.blp-malware: Blocks sites known for spreading viruses and harmful downloads.
options.blp-drugs: Blocks sites that sell or promote illegal drugs.

label: Kinds of sites to block
help: Kinds of sites that web search, page reads and answer pictures leave out. Kids, Teens and Adults each start from their own user defaults. The global defaults add kinds for everyone, and a user override adds or removes kinds for one person. The adult-site list is always on for a child or teen and no override can turn it off. Only an admin can change this, and it never shows what anyone searched for.

copy.does: Chooses which lists of blocked sites are checked when the web is searched.

options.blp-porn: Blocks sites made only for grown-ups.
options.blp-gambling: Blocks betting, casino and lottery sites.
options.blp-scam: Blocks sites known for fake offers, fake shops and fraud.
options.blp-phishing: Blocks sites that pretend to be a bank or an account page to steal a login.
options.blp-malware: Blocks sites known for spreading viruses and harmful downloads.
options.blp-drugs: Blocks sites that sell or promote illegal drugs.

label: Always block these sites
help: Sites that web search never shows for anyone, separated by commas, like example.com. A site you list here also blocks its subpages. This works for every age, and it always wins over the allowed list. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Lists sites that web search always blocks.

label: Allow these sites
help: Sites that web search may show even when a blocked-sites list has them, separated by commas, like example.com. It cannot allow an adult site for child or teen controls, and it cannot allow a site you list under Always block these sites. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Lists sites that web search may show even if a blocked-sites list has them.

label: Always block these sites for child
help: Sites that web search never shows to a child, separated by commas, like example.com, on top of the household list. A site you list here also blocks its subpages. It always wins over the allowed lists. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Hides these sites from web search, on top of the household list.

label: Allow these sites for child
help: Sites that web search may show to a child even when a blocked-sites list has them, separated by commas, like example.com, on top of the household list. It cannot allow an adult site for child or teen controls, and it cannot allow a site that is in an always-block list. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Lets web search show these sites despite a blocked-sites list, plus the household list.

label: Always block these sites for teen
help: Sites that web search never shows to a teen, separated by commas, like example.com, on top of the household list. A site you list here also blocks its subpages. It always wins over the allowed lists. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Hides these sites from web search, on top of the household list.

label: Allow these sites for teen
help: Sites that web search may show to a teen even when a blocked-sites list has them, separated by commas, like example.com, on top of the household list. It cannot allow an adult site for child or teen controls, and it cannot allow a site that is in an always-block list. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Lets web search show these sites despite a blocked-sites list, plus the household list.

label: Always block these sites for adult
help: Sites that web search never shows to an adult, separated by commas, like example.com, on top of the household list. A site you list here also blocks its subpages. It always wins over the allowed lists. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Hides these sites from web search, on top of the household list.

label: Allow these sites for adult
help: Sites that web search may show to an adult even when a blocked-sites list has them, separated by commas, like example.com, on top of the household list. It cannot allow an adult site for child or teen controls, and it cannot allow a site that is in an always-block list. Only an admin can change this.

copy.does: Lets web search show these sites despite a blocked-sites list, plus the household list.

label: Web search sources
help: Which services answer web searches. SearXNG, the household's own search service, is on by default. DuckDuckGo is not available yet. With more than one picked, their results are blended into one list. Children and teens only use SearXNG. To turn web search off, set Web searches to Library only. Pictures and videos always use SearXNG.

copy.does: Chooses which services answer web searches.

options.searxng: The household's own search service, which stays on until you change it.
options.ddgs: A second source that is not available yet.

label: Use archived pages when a source is missing
help: Check the Wayback Machine when a cited page returns not found.

label: Ask Wikipedia when web search fails or finds nothing
help: When your SearXNG instance is down or a search comes back empty, MaiPai asks Wikipedia's own official API instead - covers people, shows, places, products and history. On by default whenever web search is set up; turn it off here if you don't want it.

label: Require PIN to unlock after inactivity
help: When on, this account locks behind its PIN or password after sitting idle. Content stays put; unlocking just re-enters the PIN. Set by an owner or admin, for any account.

label: Session lock timeout (minutes)
help: How many minutes of inactivity before this account locks, when session lock is required.

label: Internet check name
help: The name MaiPai looks up once a minute to check whether internet name lookups work.

label: Check whether the internet is reachable
help: Once a minute, MaiPai looks up a neutral name and opens an empty connection to the chosen address. Turn this off to stop those checks.

label: Internet check address
help: The public IP address MaiPai connects to once a minute without sending data.

label: Internet check port
help: The port MaiPai opens and immediately closes without sending data.

label: Warn when free disk space drops below (GB)
help: A Repairs item is raised once free space on the hub's own disk drops below this.

label: Household storage cap (bytes)
help: The total bytes the whole household's files may use. 0 means no cap is set yet - the setup wizard sets this from the disk.

label: This person's storage quota (GB)
help: How much disk space this person's own uploads (cloned voices today) may use. 0 means no limit.

label: This person's storage cap override (bytes)
help: Overrides the household's default per-person cap for this one person. 0 means no override: this person follows the household default. Set by an owner or admin.

label: Default per-person storage cap (bytes)
help: How many bytes each person may use for their own files, unless that person has their own override below.

label: Speaking voice
help: The voice MaiPai uses when it reads its replies aloud to you.

label: Appearance
help: Light, dark, or match this device's own setting.

label: Enrollment sounds
help: Play soft sounds during face enrollment as the camera finds your face, then a chime when a photo is taken.

label: Look
help: Neutral is the standard black-and-white theme, the same as shadcn's own dashboard; the rest are shadcn's other color sets; Navy is MaiPai's own.

label: Pinned apps (advanced)
help: A JSON list of nav entry ids, in the order they should appear. Normally set by pinning an app, not by editing this directly.

label: Show advanced reply stats
help: Show engine timing and token details below your chat replies.

label: Allow vision when requested
help: Allows a requested camera turn. Frames are never kept for a child.

label: Hugging Face token (for voice cloning)
help: Needed to clone a voice from a recording. Accept the terms at huggingface.co/kyutai/pocket-tts, then create a read token at huggingface.co/settings/tokens and paste it here.

label: Wake word listening
help: Let this device listen locally for its wake word. Listening is always visible and can be stopped from the indicator.

label: Bodies and relationships
help: How MaiPai answers a child's questions about bodies, babies, crushes and relationships. The standard answer gently points them to you. Only a parent or admin can change a child's. It applies only while the person is on child controls and never reaches the care, safety and fairness rules, which stay the same for every child.

copy.does: Chooses how a child's questions about the body are answered.

options.default: Uses the standard answer for child controls.
options.redirect: Says it is a good question for a grown-up they trust.
options.gentle: Gives the correct body words and keeps it short.

option_labels.gentle: Answer simply with correct body words

label: Illness, death and health
help: How MaiPai answers a child's questions about illness, death, grief and medicine. The standard answer is honest, short and gentle. Only a parent or admin can change a child's. It applies only while the person is on child controls and never reaches the care, safety and fairness rules, which stay the same for every child.

copy.does: Chooses how a child's questions about illness are answered.

options.default: Uses the standard answer for child controls.
options.gentle: Answers honestly in a few gentle words.
options.redirect: Says it is a good question for a grown-up they trust.

label: Drugs, alcohol, betting and dares
help: How MaiPai answers a child's questions about medicine, drugs, alcohol, vaping, betting and dangerous dares. The standard answer explains simply that these are unsafe or for adults. Only a parent or admin can change a child's. It applies only while the person is on child controls and never reaches the care, safety and fairness rules, which stay the same for every child.

copy.does: Chooses how a child's questions about risky things are answered.

options.default: Uses the standard answer for child controls.
options.gentle: Explains that these are unsafe or for grown-ups.

label: Violence, weapons and scary news
